entities.summary: Erke Abdrashkyzy Esmahan is a Kazakhstani singer and actress. In 2009, she began performing as part of the group Inkar, but left the group in 2015 to pursue a solo career. In 2018, she played the lead role in her own film, "Mahabbat Cafe."
